'''Trask''' was a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], leader of [[Survey Team 63529]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]] on a mission to make a report to [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Greeley (Galactic Republic)|Greeley]]. The report concluded that the planet Trinta was unsuitable for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] colonization.
